items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: And Dick had been telling me they stole his trambone.

ctx.x: That's a long term. Yeah. Yeah. Well, but you do get a little pay for that. It's not just

for that. But pay? Oh sure, I get paid. But not a steady pay? No, I don't get no steady pay. See I'm not on the payroll. I'm just an officer but I'm not, I'm what you call an auxiliary. If you hire me, I get paid from you. You pay me, or your company pays me. We want you here for every night. Now it's other big deals, I go on. You see, I don't have none of them yet, I got them on at the place. I got a lot of convicts, pays $300, $400, $500, $200, $150, bond breakers. Bond breakers, get them bond breakers and…
How long that been, Dick? I was helping him move. Must have been about 52, 53, huh? Yeah. Must have been that long. Yeah, I moved. Yeah, it was, yeah, well.
